--!strict
-- Bootstrap
-- Punto de entrada del servidor. Requiere los servicios, ejecuta Init() y Start()
-- en orden controlado, y maneja errores de inicializacion de forma clara.

local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local ServicesFolder = ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Services", 10)
assert(ServicesFolder, "[Bootstrap] No se encontro ServerScriptService.Services")

local PersistenceFolder = ServicesFolder:WaitForChild("Persistence", 10)
assert(PersistenceFolder, "[Bootstrap] No se encontro ServerScriptService.Services.Persistence")
local PersistenceEnvironment = require(PersistenceFolder:WaitForChild("PersistenceEnvironment"))
local persistenceSelection = PersistenceEnvironment.Resolve()

print(string.format(
	"[Bootstrap] PersistenceEnvironment=%s PersistenceProvider=%s WritesToCloud=%s GameId=%d PlaceId=%d",
	persistenceSelection.Environment,
	persistenceSelection.ProviderName,
	tostring(persistenceSelection.WritesToCloud),
	persistenceSelection.GameId,
	persistenceSelection.PlaceId
))
if persistenceSelection.BlockedReason then
	warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Persistencia bloqueada de forma segura: %s", persistenceSelection.BlockedReason))
end

-- Seal the approved ability catalog before ShopService builds its products.
-- Publish physical Slap metadata/previews before any service requires the shared Catalog.
require(ServicesFolder:WaitForChild('Crates'):WaitForChild('SlapResourceRegistry')).Publish()
-- Only direct, explicitly named ModuleScripts are eligible for require.
local abilityFolder = ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Abilities")
local AbilityRegistry = require(ServicesFolder:WaitForChild("AbilityRegistry"))
local AbilityAssets = require(abilityFolder:WaitForChild("AbilityAssetValidator"))
AbilityRegistry.Initialize({
 Manifest = require(abilityFolder:WaitForChild("AbilityManifest")),
 DefaultId = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.AbilityDefinitions).DefaultId,
 Resolve = function(name)
  local found
  for _,child in ipairs(abilityFolder:GetChildren()) do
   if child.Name == name then
    assert(found == nil, "AmbiguousAbilityModule: " .. name)
    found = child
   end
  end
  return found
 end,
 IsModule = function(value) return value:IsA("ModuleScript") and value.Parent == abilityFolder end,
 Load = require,
 HasDependency = function(name)
  local dependency = abilityFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
  return name == "MovementGuard" and dependency ~= nil and dependency:IsA("ModuleScript")
 end,
 CheckAssets = function(assets)
  return AbilityAssets.Validate(assets, game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AbilityEffects"))
 end,
 Warn = warn,
})

-- Orden de carga controlado. Cada servicio expone Name, Init(context) y Start(context).
local SERVICE_ORDER = {
	"PlayerDataService",
	"PlayerService",
	"ShopService",
	"RagdollService",
	"MatchInstanceService",
	"SpawnService",
	"PointFeedbackService",
	"PointEffectTestService",
	"ScoreService",
	"RoundService",
	"MatchmakingFeedbackService",
	"MatchmakingService",
	"CombatService",
	"KnockbackService",
	"EliminationService",
	"DeathEffectService",
	"SlapService",
	"AbilityService",
	"CrateService",
	"CoinShopAccessService",
	"PremiumShopService",
	"SocialPlayService",
	"SocialService",
	"TrainingService",
	"AdminService",
}

local loadedServices: { [string]: any } = {}
local initializedServices = {}

-- Carga de modulos
for _, name in ipairs(SERVICE_ORDER) do
	local moduleScript = ServicesFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not moduleScript or not moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Servicio no encontrado o invalido: %s", name))
		continue
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(require, moduleScript)
	if not ok then
		warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Error al requerir %s: %s", name, tostring(result)))
		continue
	end

	loadedServices[name] = result
end

-- Contexto compartido: permite referencias controladas sin dependencias circulares.
local context = {
	Services = loadedServices,
	PersistenceProvider = persistenceSelection.Provider,
	PersistenceInfo = persistenceSelection,
	GetService = function(_self, name: string)
		return loadedServices[name]
	end,
}

-- Init() en todos
for _, name in ipairs(SERVICE_ORDER) do
	local service = loadedServices[name]
	if not service then
		continue
	end

	if type(service.Init) == "function" then
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			service:Init(context)
		end)
		if ok then
			table.insert(initializedServices, name)
		else
			warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Error en Init() de %s: %s", name, tostring(err)))
		end
	else
		warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] %s no implementa Init()", name))
	end
end

-- Start() en todos
for _, name in ipairs(SERVICE_ORDER) do
	local service = loadedServices[name]
	if not service then
		continue
	end

	if type(service.Start) == "function" then
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			service:Start(context)
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Error en Start() de %s: %s", name, tostring(err)))
		end
	else
		warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] %s no implementa Start()", name))
	end
end

print(string.format("[Bootstrap] Servicios inicializados: %s", table.concat(initializedServices, ", ")))
print("[Bootstrap] Arranque completado")

--!nonstrict
-- Only physical Tools in two server-owned folders are inspected. Never require asset scripts.
local Registry={}
local function id(value)
 return type(value)=='string'and #value>0 and #value<=64 and value:match('^[%w_%-]+$')~=nil
end
local function canonical(name)return name:gsub('^Slap_','')end
local function unique(parent)
 local seen={};if parent then for _,o in ipairs(parent:GetChildren())do assert(not seen[o.Name],'DuplicateSlapResource:'..o.Name);seen[o.Name]=o end end;return seen
end
local function valid(tool)
 if not tool or not tool:IsA('Tool')then return false end
 local hand=tool:FindFirstChild('Hand');local c=tool:FindFirstChild('Configuration')
 local p=c and c:FindFirstChild('Power');local cd=c and c:FindFirstChild('SlapCooldown')
 return hand and hand:IsA('BasePart')and p and p:IsA('NumberValue')and p.Value==p.Value and p.Value>0 and p.Value<math.huge
  and cd and cd:IsA('NumberValue')and cd.Value==cd.Value and cd.Value>=0 and cd.Value<math.huge
end
function Registry.Discover(slaps,variants,variations)
 local known={};for _,v in ipairs(variations)do known[v.Id]=v end
 local models={};local diagnostics={}
 for _,tool in pairs(unique(slaps))do
  if valid(tool)then
   local key=tool:GetAttribute('SlapId')or canonical(tool.Name);assert(id(key),'InvalidSlapId')
   assert(not models[key],'DuplicateSlapId:'..key)
   models[key]={SlapId=key,Model=tool.Name,DisplayName=tool:GetAttribute('DisplayName')or(key=='Classic'and 'Clásico'or key),Base=tool,Templates={Basic=tool}}
  else table.insert(diagnostics,'Invalid base: '..tool.Name)end
 end
 for _,folder in pairs(unique(variants))do
  if folder:IsA('Folder')then
   local key=folder:GetAttribute('SlapId')or canonical(folder.Name);assert(id(key),'InvalidSlapFolder')
   local model=models[key]
   if not model then model={SlapId=key,Model=folder:GetAttribute('BaseModel')or key,DisplayName=folder:GetAttribute('DisplayName')or key,Templates={}};models[key]=model end
   assert(not model.VariantsFolder,'AmbiguousSlapVariants:'..key);model.VariantsFolder=folder.Name
   for name,tool in pairs(unique(folder))do
    if known[name]and valid(tool)then model.Templates[name]=tool
    else table.insert(diagnostics,'Invalid/unknown variant: '..folder.Name..'/'..name)end
   end
  end
 end
 local result={}
 for _,model in pairs(models)do
  model.VariationIds={}
  for _,v in ipairs(variations)do if model.Templates[v.Id]then table.insert(model.VariationIds,v.Id)end end
  if #model.VariationIds>0 then table.insert(result,model)end
 end
 table.sort(result,function(a,b)return a.SlapId<b.SlapId end)
 local default=false;for _,m in ipairs(result)do if m.SlapId=='Classic'and m.Templates.Basic then default=true end end
 assert(default,'DefaultClassicBasicRequired')
 return result,diagnostics
end
function Registry.Preview(tool,name)
 local copy=tool:Clone();local model=Instance.new('Model');model.Name=name
 for _,child in ipairs(copy:GetChildren())do child.Parent=model end;copy:Destroy()
 model.PrimaryPart=model:FindFirstChild('Hand')
 if model.PrimaryPart then model.PrimaryPart:SetAttribute('SlapVariationAuthored',true)end
 for _,o in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
  if o:IsA('LuaSourceContainer')then o:Destroy()
  elseif o:IsA('BasePart')then o.Anchored=true;o.CanCollide=false;o.CanTouch=false;o.CanQuery=false end
 end
 return model
end
function Registry.Publish()
 local rs=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage');local ss=game:GetService('ServerStorage')
 local variations=require(rs.Shared.SlapCrates.VariationDefinitions)
 local models,diagnostics=Registry.Discover(ss:FindFirstChild('Slaps'),ss:FindFirstChild('SlapVariations'),variations)
 local metadata=Instance.new('Folder');metadata.Name='SlapCatalog';metadata:SetAttribute('SchemaVersion',1)
 local previews=Instance.new('Folder');previews.Name='SlapVariationPreviews'
 local bases=Instance.new('Folder');bases.Name='CrateRewardPreviews'
 for _,model in ipairs(models)do
  local entry=Instance.new('Folder');entry.Name=model.SlapId
  entry:SetAttribute('Model',model.Model);entry:SetAttribute('DisplayName',model.DisplayName)
  entry:SetAttribute('VariantsFolder',model.VariantsFolder or model.SlapId)
  local names=Instance.new('Folder');names.Name='Variations';names.Parent=entry
  local visuals=Instance.new('Folder');visuals.Name=model.SlapId
  for _,variation in ipairs(model.VariationIds)do
   local marker=Instance.new('Folder');marker.Name=variation;marker.Parent=names
   local preview=Registry.Preview(model.Templates[variation],variation)
   preview:SetAttribute('SlapId',model.SlapId);preview:SetAttribute('VariationId',variation)
   preview:SetAttribute('PreviewOfRewardId',model.SlapId..':'..variation);preview.Parent=visuals
  end
  local base=Registry.Preview(model.Templates.Basic or model.Templates[model.VariationIds[1]],model.SlapId);base.Parent=bases
  entry.Parent=metadata;visuals.Parent=previews
 end
 -- Build first, then publish. Clients wait for the runtime-ready marker before requiring Catalog.
 rs:SetAttribute('SlapCatalogReady',false)
 for _,new in ipairs({metadata,previews,bases})do local old=rs:FindFirstChild(new.Name);if old then old:Destroy()end;new.Parent=rs end
 rs:SetAttribute('SlapCatalogReady',true)
 for _,message in ipairs(diagnostics)do warn('[SlapCatalog] '..message)end
 print('[SlapCatalog] Registered '..#models..' physical Slap models')
 return models,diagnostics
end
return Registry

--!nonstrict
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SS=game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local PolicyService=game:GetService("PolicyService")
local Http=game:GetService("HttpService")
local Catalog=require(RS.Shared.SlapCrates.Catalog)
local Appearance=require(RS.Shared.SlapCrates.Appearance)
local Inventory=require(RS.Shared.SlapCrates.Inventory)
local Odds=require(RS.Shared.SlapCrates.Odds)
local Batch=require(RS.Shared.SlapCrates.BatchOpening)
local Engine=require(script.Parent.Crates.CrateEngine)
local Stock=require(script.Parent.Crates.InMemoryStock)
local Announcements=require(script.Parent.Crates.AnnouncementAdapter)
local StandOpening=require(script.Parent.Crates.StandOpeningService)
local Service={Name="CrateService"}
local function ensure(parent,name,class)
 local obj=parent:FindFirstChild(name)
 if obj then assert(obj:IsA(class),"Crate resource class conflict: "..name);return obj end
 obj=Instance.new(class);obj.Name=name;obj.Parent=parent;return obj
end
function Service:Init(context)
 self._context=context;self._quotes={};self._premiumQuotes={};self._rate={};self._cancelRate={};self._connections={}
 self._announcements=Announcements.new(function(packet)self._announce:FireAllClients(packet)end)
 self._stock=if RunService:IsStudio() and context.PersistenceInfo and context.PersistenceInfo.Environment=="Studio" and context.PersistenceInfo.ProviderName=="InMemory"
  and context.PersistenceInfo.WritesToCloud==false then Stock.new() else nil
 self._rng=Random.new()
 self._stands=StandOpening.new(self)
end
function Service:_players()return self._context:GetService("PlayerService")end
function Service:ExtendInventory(inv)return Inventory.Extend(inv)end
function Service:_lobby(player)
 local rounds=self._context:GetService("RoundService")
 return player.Parent==Players and not player:GetAttribute("MatchId") and not player:GetAttribute("ResultsSessionId")
  and rounds~=nil and rounds:GetSessionForPlayer(player)==nil
end
function Service:_resource(reward)
 local slap=Catalog.Slaps.ById[reward.SlapId];local v=Catalog.Variations.ById[reward.VariationId]
 local tool=self:GetRewardTemplate(reward)
 local profiles=RS:FindFirstChild("SlapVariationEffects")
 if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") or not v or not profiles or not profiles:FindFirstChild(v.VisualProfile)then return false end
 local config=tool:FindFirstChild("Configuration");local power=config and config:FindFirstChild("Power");local cooldown=config and config:FindFirstChild("SlapCooldown")
 local previews=RS:FindFirstChild("CrateRewardPreviews")
 return power~=nil and power:IsA("NumberValue") and power.Value>0 and power.Value<math.huge
  and cooldown~=nil and cooldown:IsA("NumberValue") and cooldown.Value>=0 and cooldown.Value<math.huge
  and previews~=nil and previews:FindFirstChild(reward.SlapId)~=nil
end
function Service:_eligible(player,crate,reviewQuote)
 if not self._stock then return false,"ProductionBackendBlocked" end
 if not crate or (crate.StudioOnly and (not RunService:IsStudio() or SS:GetAttribute("CrateStudioTestsEnabled")~=true)) then return false,"CrateUnavailable" end
 if not Engine.Approved(crate)and not(reviewQuote and crate.MatrixVersion=="InitialV13Review")then return false,"CommercialApprovalPending" end
 if not self:_lobby(player) then return false,"LobbyOnly" end
 if not self:_players():IsShopDataReady(player)then return false,"DataNotLoaded" end
 -- Coins may be Robux-funded. No client claims or Studio bypass of this policy.
 local ok,policy=pcall(PolicyService.GetPolicyInfoForPlayerAsync,PolicyService,player)
 if not ok or type(policy)~="table" or policy.ArePaidRandomItemsRestricted~=false then return false,"PaidRandomItemsRestricted" end

--!nonstrict
-- Weight of a variation is divided equally among its currently eligible base Slaps.
local Odds={}
function Odds.Resolve(crate,catalog,inventory,stock,resourcesAvailable)
 local results={};local excluded={};local total=0;local hasWeights=false
 for vid,weight in pairs(crate.Weights)do
  hasWeights=true
  if not catalog.Variations.ById[vid] or type(weight)~="number" or weight~=weight or weight<0 or weight==math.huge then return nil,"InvalidWeights" end
  if weight==0 then continue end
  local candidates={}
  for id,reward in pairs(catalog.Rewards)do
   if reward.VariationId~=vid then continue end
   if crate.DuplicatePolicy=="UniquePerPlayer" and inventory.Owned.Slaps[id] then table.insert(excluded,{Reward=reward,Reason="AlreadyOwned"});continue end
   if resourcesAvailable and not resourcesAvailable(reward)then table.insert(excluded,{Reward=reward,Reason="ResourceUnavailable"});continue end
   local view,reason=stock:View(reward,catalog.Variations.ById[vid])
   if not view then return nil,reason or "StockUnknown" end
   if not view.SoldOut then table.insert(candidates,{Reward=reward,Stock=view})else table.insert(excluded,{Reward=reward,Stock=view,Reason="SoldOut"})end
  end
  if #candidates==0 and crate.RequireAllWeightedVariations then return nil,'RequiredVariationUnavailable',excluded end
  for _,row in ipairs(candidates)do row.Weight=weight/#candidates;total+=row.Weight;table.insert(results,row)end
 end
 if not hasWeights or total<=0 or total==math.huge then return nil,"NoEligibleResults",excluded end
 table.sort(results,function(a,b)return a.Reward.RewardId<b.Reward.RewardId end)
 for _,row in ipairs(results)do row.Probability=row.Weight/total;row.Percent=row.Probability*100 end

end

 assert(type(unit)=="number" and unit>=0 and unit<1,"InvalidRandom")
 local sum=0 for _,row in ipairs(results)do sum+=row.Probability;if unit<sum then return row.Reward end end
 return results[#results].Reward
end
return Odds
